observed_problem: The current Quality Bundle accepts a fixed universal list of eleven free-text all-PASS check rows for every edition. A row does not prove which validator ran, which result artifact was produced, or that the check actually evaluated the exact source/PDF bytes. The same Long-form-specific checks are also required for Weekly even when semantically inapplicable.
expected_behavior: Every applicable quality result must be machine-verifiable and bound to validator/check contract identity plus exact source/PDF authority. The expected check set must be derived from Core + Research Profile + Publication Profile so inapplicable checks are absent rather than ceremonially passed.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_quality_v2.py treats status=PASS and free-text evidence as sufficient once every globally required check_id is present; tests/test_survey_quality_v2.py demonstrates fixture PASS rows with descriptive evidence strings rather than executed-validator attestations.
production_workaround: Do not approve or merge PR #310. WU-012C must replace self-attested universal rows with Profile-aware exact-byte check attestations before production validation.
improvement_action: Implement WU-012C: define Profile-aware expected quality checks and require each PASS to bind check contract/version, validator identity, exact source SHA-256, exact PDF SHA-256 when relevant, and a durable result artifact/digest. Preserve only two Human Gates.
